description: The category codes of the muscle category key. A set or compartment is the FMA 5.1.0 set of that term, anchored to its FMA id and, where UBERON has it, its UBERON id; its members are the ones FMA asserts. An action category holds the prime movers of one joint action of the exercise key. muscles lists every category's members followed down to muscle keys.
